Before you
press play.

Does it come with music?+

Caimack plays the music you bring. Connect your existing folder or upload MP3 and FLAC albums. Explore the public demo before setting up your own server.

How do the recommendations work?+

Caimack combines your listening history with local audio analysis. Your server downloads an audio model and analyses the collection in the background. You can listen while it works.

What do I need to host it?+

A server with Docker and Docker Compose v2, a domain pointing at it, and your music. The repository includes setup, update and Android build instructions.

Is Caimack open source?+

Yes. The current code is licensed under AGPL-3.0. You can read it, host it, modify it and contribute on GitHub, subject to the license conditions.
